entries.text_de:
Exeter, Kathedrale, 'Liber pontificalis of Edmund Lacy, bishop of Exeter [†1455], a ms. of the 14. cent.'4, ed. R. Barnes, Ex. 1847. P. 138 Krönungseid mit Bestätigung der leges a rege Edwardo concessae, also anders und später als Sacr cor.

Hinter Benedictio novi militis: p. 211 Duel bis 8, 2, u. S. 430, wo, da ich das Buch zu spät erst kaufen konnte, die Varianten nicht mehr eingefügt wurden. Sie sind bedeutungslos: nur auf S. 43124 steht statt des Priesters episcopo, sicher zumeist unzutreffend.

P. 287 Excom. II, u. S. 434.
entries.text_en:
Exeter, Cathedral, 'Liber pontificalis of Edmund Lacy, bishop of Exeter [†1455], a ms. of the 14. cent.'4, ed. R. Barnes, Exeter 1847. P. 138 coronation oath with confirmation of the leges a rege Edwardo concessae, thus different from and later than Sacr cor.

After Benedictio novi militis: p. 211 Duel as far as 8, 2, below, p. 430, where, since I was able to buy the book only too late, the variants were not inserted. They are insignificant: only on p. 43124 does episcopo stand instead of the priest, certainly in most cases inappropriate.

P. 287 Excom. II, below, p. 434.

transcription.doubts: '431<sup>24</sup>' is a page-and-note reference. 'Excom. II' confirmed. 'Sacr cor' here is roman (checked). 'R. Barnes' confirmed.
